B.definition: close > SMA(200) and MACD(12,26,9) and 30 <= RSI(14) <= 70

D.definition: exact permutation of the analyst's own direction multiset

cadence.authority: CAP-003 sealed its four real decisions at the 2026-10-06 16:00 UTC boundary; that slot is reused rather than replaced
cadence.rule: one decision per asset per UTC day at the decision slot

checkpoint_policy: IDEMPOTENT_APPEND_ONLY: a checkpoint is written once for its population and is never silently rewritten with a different decision set

cohorts.CAP004-REAL-DECISIONS-V1: decisions sealed by CAP-004 with full campaign provenance
cohorts.LEGACY_CAP003_PILOT: the four CAP-003 pilot decisions, adopted as-is because rewriting their provenance would break ledger immutability

model_policy.note: the analyst is the LLM client; the repository never synthesises its answer, and a provider that exposes no sampling parameter must record NOT_EXPOSED

primary_metric.definition: the CAP-003 alpha scorecard conclusion, i.e. all incremental edges of A versus B (frozen deterministic rule), C (buy-and-hold) and D (random matched distribution) strictly positive
primary_metric.name: G_AGENTIC_EDGE
primary_metric.note: frozen by CAP-003 and never redefined by CAP-004
